In this question three statements are given followed by three conclusions I, II and III. You have to consider the three statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

**Statements:**

Some bricks are metals.

All metals are shiny.

No shiny thing can float.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some metals can float.

(II) No brick can float.

(III) Some bricks are shiny.

options.text: All conclusions I, II and III follow.

questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0a3c6192b06471133560f5e01fad35460d44206f26e9306154931966805682a.png] 

Conclusions:

Some metals can float → False (As all metals are shiny and no shiny thing can float, which means that no metal can float).

No brick can float → False (No direct relation given between brick and float, so it can be possible, not definite).

Some bricks are shiny → **True **(Some bricks are metals and all metals are shiny, so those part of brick that is metals, will also shiny)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

 ×

7 ÷ 20 – 5 × 20 + 2 

After interchanging the signs it will be

7 + 20 × __**5 ÷ 20**__ - 2 

= 7 + __**20 **____**× .25**__ - 2

= __**7 + 5**__ - 2

= **__12 - 2__**

= 10

Hence the correct answer is **"*****10".***

questions.question:
'A & B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’.

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’.

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the son of B’.

Which of the following options means, ‘L is the father of O’?
questions.solution:
Family chart:

 [IMAGE: https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/FyD9L3PCPvZsHa5nynlMPf_fzf_aXK9tKopSaDWxBYVwFRo-6fzjiv7HQG28YUhFJ0nLGj9_hEV_JqW5NQsWS_FX2dnhd3UTkTZ5DE4dKFyqgfFDku2-8QBz2pL7YIeD6iwR5lii] 

Given:‘A & B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’.

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’.

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the son of B’.

Let us first decode the given symbols and then draw a family tree

 
 

 **A is**
 
 

 
 
**Symbol**

 
 
 
@

 
 
 
&

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
 [IMAGE: file:///C:\Users\Sumona\AppData\Local\Temp\msohtmlclip1\01\clip_image002.gif] ×

 
 
 

 
 
**Meaning**

 
 
 
Son

 
 
 
Sister

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
Husband

 
 
 

 **of B**
 
 

 

Now, checking the options to find, ‘L is the father of O’.

Option 1: L & M × N @ O

L & M means L is the sister of M.

M × N means M the husband of N.

N @ O means N is the son of O.

So option (1) is not true. Because **N cannot be male and female at the same time.**

Option 2: **L × M – N & O **

Here L × M means L is the husband of M.

M - N means M is the mother of N. So it can be said that L is the father of N.

Now N & O means N is the sister of O . So the father of O is also L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3780392d681963c56dc0fa7c7a9daa232545121b7e4f567acbe6adb8b300542e.png] 

Here, ***‘L is the father of O***’.

Optionc 3: says L × M – N × O

L × M says that L is the husband of M.

M - N says M is the mother of N.

N × O-says N is the husband of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/702dc5b74d2073f05b7731eacb644c2ca471492662a780506378413ee91c13d4.png] 

So, L is father in law of O.

Option 4: L @ M – N & O 

L @ M says that L is the son of M.

M-N says that M is the mother of N.

N & O says that N is the sister of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b465f45db565d654de23e0ac80507fd0a885ec238553cc2703a6207f53bc718e.png] 

So, L is brother of O.

So option (2) *L × M – N & O* represents *‘L is the father of O*’.

Hence, the correct answer is: ***Option (2).***

questions.question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are seven friends having different heights. A is taller than C but shorter than B. C is taller than F but shorter than A. B is taller than A but shorter than 2 persons. D is taller than B. E is not the tallest and G is the shortest. How many people are taller than C?
questions.solution:
According to given information, we have the possible arrangements as follows:

1). A is taller than C but shorter than B.

B > A > C

2). C is taller than F but shorter than A.

A > C > F

3). B is taller than A but shorter than 2 persons. 

2 people > B > A

4). D is taller than B.

D > B

5). E is not the tallest and G is the shortest. 

After combining all the arrangements, we get: **D > E > B > A > C > F > G**

Here, there are total **4 people** that are taller than C, that are D, E, B and A.

Hence, **"4"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which two numbers from amongst the given options should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

108 ÷ 3 - 126 ÷ ( 5 × 3 + 12) + 4 = 11
questions.solution:
The following equation will be solved using the **BODMAS rule**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08545c8b44a06c215c77c8ea0a5c29c217990241eed733a74576f30e54dd0b64.png] 

 Let us check all the options:

 1. Option 1) 11 and 12, the equation becomes 108 ÷ 3 - 126 ÷ (5 × 3 + 11) + 4 = 12.

 On solving the equation, we get: 36 - 126 ÷ 26 + 4 = 36 - 4.85 + 4 = 31.15 + 4 = 35.15

 As, 35.15 is not equal to 12. So, this option is incorrect.

 2. Option 2) 12 and 3,** the equation becomes 108 ÷ 12 - 126 ÷ (5 × 12 + 3) + 4 = 11.**

** On solving the equation, we get: **108 ÷ 12** - 126 ÷ 63 + 4 = 9 - 2 + 4 = 7 + 4 = 11**

** As 11 = 11, option 2 is correct.**

 3. Option 3) 12 and 4, the equation becomes 108 ÷ 3 - 126 ÷ (5 × 3 + 4) + 12 = 11. 

 On solving the equation, we get: 36 - 126 ÷ 19 + 12 = 36 - 6.63 + 12 = 41.37

 As, 41.37 is not equal to 11, thus this option is incorrect.

 **4****. Option​ 4) 126 and 108**, the equation becomes 126 ÷ 3 - 108 ÷ (5 × 3 + 12) + 4 = 11. 

 On solving the equation, we get: 42 - 108 ÷ 27 + 4 = 42 - 4 + 4 = 42

 As, 42 is not equal to 11, thus this option is incorrect.

 **Hence, the correct answer is:** "**Option (2)"*****.***

​ ​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__**

questions.question: What was the day of the week on 24 August 1923?
questions.solution:
The **formula **for calculating the day of the week is:

 **(Year Code + Month Code + Century Code + Date Number - Leap Year Code) mod 7**

** 'Mod' **means to divide a number and keep only the remainder.

** For 24 August ****1923:**

 
• **Year Code** - (YY+ (YY div 4)) { mod } 7 = (23+(23÷4({discard the remainder})) / 7 = (23 + 5) / 7 = 28 / 7 = 0 .
 
• **Month Code **- 2
 
• **Century Code** - 0
 
• **Date number **- 24
 
• **Leap year code** - 0
